title: Q-GROW-MARKDOWN-PAGES: GROW-11: markdown content negotiation for every page
body:
**Owner:** product-manager
**Trigger:** executor tick, driver order
**Done check:** grep:site/worker.js::text/markdown
**Status:** open

Return a Markdown rendering of each page when the request sends Accept: text/markdown, with an x-markdown-tokens header, so agents read the site cheaply. Paths: site/worker.js, site/site.test.mjs.

Metric moved: agent_hits_7d. Prediction: agent_hits_7d rises at least 20 percent within 14 days of the change (baseline 817, today None, expected today 905.9). Keep only if the target moved and no guard worsened.

size: M

**Closing probe:** grep:site/worker.js::text/markdown.
